description_en: Retrieves the file upload policy information, such as the upload address, for uploading files to a honeypot
description_zh: 当需要向蜜罐中上传文件时，先通过此接口中获取文件上传的地址等信息
name: GetHoneyPotUploadPolicyInfo

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Code.description_en: The status code of the request

Accessid.description_en: The AccessKey ID required for the upload

Expire.description_en: The expiration time of the authorization in UNIX timestamp format. You can use this value to check whether the authorization is valid. The authorization becomes unavailable after it expires
Expire.description_zh: 授权失效时间，时间戳格式，可以判断授权是否在有效期内，失效后授权不可用

Host.description_en: The request URL for the upload

Key.description_en: The name of the object uploaded by calling the PostObject operation of OSS, including the full path of the OSS object
Key.description_zh: 调用OSS的接口PostObject上传对象（即文件）的名称，包含OSS对象的完整路径

Policy.description_en: The restriction policy for file uploads, such as the file size limit
Policy.description_zh: 文件上传的限制策略，如文件大小

Signature.description_en: The signature calculated based on the AccessKeySecret and Policy. When you call an OSS API operation, OSS verifies the signature to confirm the validity of the POST request
Signature.description_zh: 根据AccessKeySecret和Policy计算出的签名信息。调用OSS API时，OSS验证该签名信息，从而确认Post请求的合法性

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the response
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 请求数据结果的HTTP状态码

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
